faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Corte Madera?
faq.answer: Corte Madera homeowners typically invest $7,000 to $16,000 for a full window replacement project. This affluent Marin community features a mix of mid-century ranches and contemporary homes, many with larger windows framing views of Mt. Tamalpais or the Bay. Single window installation starts at approximately $600.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Corte Madera?
faq.answer: Yes. Corte Madera requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications and coordinates with Corte Madera's Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Corte Madera?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Corte Madera commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Corte Madera?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Corte Madera replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Corte Madera?
faq.answer: Most Corte Madera projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
